paragraphs.text: RETIRED: three-column DOM shim for DSH web — stamps data-pane/data-dsh-frame so plugins could target
sidebar/conversation/details without depending on official class names. Retired because only one UI
stack remains and nothing consumed the markers. Kept for reference.
Standalone three-column shim for DeepSeek Harness web UI.
Stamps `data-pane="sidebar|conversation|details"` and `data-dsh-frame` on the layout so other plugin
s (notemap, web-ui-all, ...) can target columns without depending on official DOM class names.
Health marker: `data-dsh-shim-mounted` on  - verify with guide_boot uiChecks.
